canonical_project: Africa Data Centres Samrand (JHB2) expansion 10MW to 40MW

location.subnational: Gauteng - City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality

notes: ADC official release: ground broken Aug 2022 on Samrand facility expansion from 10MW to 40MW IT load; phase 1 delivers 20MW across eight data halls by 2023, additional 10MW targeted by end-2025 (IT-Online); TechCentral TCS+ (2025) says facility (one of Africa's few Tier IV colos, built by Standard Bank in 2010) to house an additional 20MW when upgrades complete in 2025. Samrand Business Park, Centurion = City of Tshwane (sources often mislabel as Johannesburg). Status: original facility operational; expansion in phased construction.
